items.title: Add source lineage record model and learning collectors
items.context: Implement a read-only core projection for learning-domain artifacts: dev-memory entries, finding-signals, playbook proposals/candidates/outcomes/decisions, and raw finding-backed source keys where available.
items.userSees: JSON output includes "canonicalSourceKey", "canonicalSourceKeyVersion", and "canonicalizationPolicyHash" for learning lineage records.

happy.desc: Synthetic learning artifacts with the same sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/signature are grouped under one duplicate canonical source key.

edge.desc: Missing or malformed lineage is reported as diagnostics instead of throwing or silently disappearing.

adversarial.desc: Non-authoritative derived artifacts cannot masquerade as gate evidence or independent sources in the audit output.

items.title: Expose host-neutral source_lineage_audit command
items.context: Register lattice source_lineage_audit --domain=learning --json as read-only/L0, with no codex/claude namespace alias and no writes to .lattice learning stores.
items.userSees: Running "lattice source_lineage_audit --domain=learning --json" prints duplicate groups, missingLineageCount, and authority/gateEvidence fields.

happy.desc: CLI emits host-neutral JSON for --domain=learning with counts, duplicate canonical source groups, and no mutation.

edge.desc: Unsupported domains fail with a clear source_lineage_audit diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: Command policy and process fact classify source_lineage_audit as readOnly/L0 and not a host-adapter command.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage and update execution-plan docs
items.context: Cover duplicate grouping, missing lineage, non-authoritative gate boundary, real-store empty posture, and document that this is M1 only: audit, not seed promotion or auto-promotion.
items.userSees: Smoke output ends with "source lineage audit smoke passed" and the execution plan names M1 as read-only audit only.

happy.desc: Focused smoke covers duplicate source grouping and real-store read-only audit posture.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly state M1 does not create proposals, candidates, outcomes, promotion decisions, or active playbooks.

adversarial.desc: Audit output cannot satisfy lifecycle gate evidence and leaves learning stores unchanged.
